2607.06598.title: Non-contact, Real-time, Heart-rate Measurement using Image Processing with Commodity Cameras and AI Agents
2607.06598.paper_summary: Heart rate measurement is one of the key requirements for real-time health monitoring, in particular for health caring of elderly people. Traditional heart rate measurement relies on contact sensing mechanisms such as some heart rate measurement devices at medical hospitals or some wearable devices with embedded sensors such as Apple Watch, etc. In this paper, we develop a system for non-contact, real-time, heart rate measurement using image processing with commodity cameras such as an embedded camera on a laptop, where we use an innovative algorithm to capture the relevant signals for the computation of heart rate in a time series in real life environments. The presented heart rate computation (HRC) process is composed with four major steps: (a) identify frames per second of the camera in use, i.e., 30 frames per second for a given camera, (b) face detection (FD) with shape predictor of 68 face landmarks using deep learning (DL) method, (c) time sliding window (TSW) algorithm to de-noise the signal by smoothing out the noise, and (d) compute heart rate based on identified signal periodicity. We test and analyze the developed prototypes against heart rate results by Apple Watch and check the difference range in multiple rounds and compute the mean of the difference for the measurement values of the heart rate of the same person at the same time. We will do further tuning and optimization of the present methods and deploy the system as a personal AI agent [6] for health monitoring as our future directions.
2607.06598.paper_summary_zh: 心率測量是實時健康監測的關鍵要求之一，特別是對老年人的健康護理。傳統的心率測量依賴於接觸感測機制，例如醫療機構中的一些心率測量設備或一些嵌入式傳感器的可穿戴設備，如Apple Watch等。在本文中，我們開發了一個使用圖像處理的非接觸式實時心率測量系統，利用普通相機，如筆記型電腦上的嵌入式相機，我們使用一種創新的算法來捕捉相關信號，以計算現實環境中時間序列的心率。所提出的心率計算（HRC）過程由四個主要步驟組成：（a）識別所用相機的幀率，即給定相機的每秒30幀，（b）使用深度學習（DL）方法進行面部檢測（FD），並利用68個面部標誌的形狀預測器，（c）時間滑動窗口（TSW）算法通過平滑噪聲來去除信號中的噪聲，以及（d）根據識別的信號週期性計算心率。我們測試並分析了開發的原型，與Apple Watch的心率結果進行比較，檢查多輪測試中的差異範圍，並計算同一時間同一人的心率測量值的差異均值。我們將進一步調整和優化目前的方法，並將系統部署為個人AI代理[6]，以用於健康監測，作為我們的未來方向。
